text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Central vs. Local. The champion Crimson 
Nova vs. Funabashi's Furioso.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fans and the media alike were hyped over 
the clash between the superstar and the 
local hero.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Furioso, give it everything you've got—!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Everyone's cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is a saying: "sympathy for the 
underdog." People were favorable toward 
the young challenger.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"If Furioso can defeat Crimson Nova, 
wouldn't that be a truly remarkable feat?"

text_block_list.name: Analysis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Just challenging it takes real 
courage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And on the day of the JBC Classic. 'That 
time' had finally come."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what is that...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clank)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
That racing racewear... Is the one coming 
over here—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That unmistakable attire... Standing in 
the setting sun that day, she truly was 
the 'Crimson Fiend.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Crimson Nova. One of the strongest on the 
JRA dirt tracks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click, clack, click, clack)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clank)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Umâ

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suppressing the shiver running down my 
spine... I could barely manage to squeeze 
out a greeting.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Glaring eyes. A thoroughly tempered body. 
A terrifying aura. So this is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Crimson... Nova...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Did she just glance over here? No, must be 
my imagination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click, clack, click, clack)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, Crimson Nova left without 
uttering a single word.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(The way she acted just now... Does that 
mean she doesn't consider me a threat?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched over Furioso as she stood in the 
paddock looking frustrated. And then...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text:
M-Maybe it would've been better if I 
hadn't come...?

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, right~...? Even though Furi-pyon 
might end up having a terrible time~

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Samin
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... I came to cheer for Furi-chan...

text_block_list.name: Funabashi Umamusume Myu
text_block_list.text:
I don't really wanna look, but... then 
again, maybe I kinda do~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso is not the only one fighting 
against fear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were Umamusume trying to face the 
memory of blood, and the reality of 
Funabashi, step by step.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(The first race of a three-race streak. 
First, with this one battle—)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(I will make them acknowledge my presence! 
Without fail!)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
(We are—no longer the weaklings who will 
just let ourselves be trampled on.)

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Don't you dare... underestimate Funabashi.
